title: Building Seasonal Highways for Residential Energy Hubs: Sizing, planning and operating thermal energy storage
summary: The operation of residential energy hubs with multiple energy carriers (electricity, heat, mobility) poses a significant challenge due to the energy storage differences in time-constants, round-trip efficiencies and self-discharge rates. Usually, thermal storage exhibits flexibility in yearly planning optimizations or long-term scenarios. However, as optimization horizons shrink (1-48hs) so does their supplied value due to the lower round-trip efficiencies.
